en-US.description: hiro is a personal test build with customizable on-screen presentation, viewing protection and device connectivity.
en-US.whats_new: Restores the earlier Live Activity presentation and simplifies the available styles. Please check the Dynamic Island after opening hiro and returning to the Home Screen.

zh-Hans.description: hiro 是用于个人测试的应用版本，提供可自定义的界面展示、查看保护和设备连接功能。
zh-Hans.whats_new: 恢复早期实时活动展示，简化样式选择。请打开 hiro 后回到主屏幕，检查灵动岛显示。
